The masked region in `MountService.java` is fully reconstructed and the project builds cleanly.

**What I implemented** (replacing the single `<MASKED>` placeholder in `src/main/java/com/cachefs/platform/service/MountService.java`):

- `executeMount(Long mountId, String username)` — loads the mount via `CacheMountMapper.findById` and the actor via `UserMapper.findByUsername`, then spawns `mount -t <fsType> -o <options> <sourcePath> <targetPath>` (options defaulting to `"defaults"` when null).
- `executeUnmount(Long mountId, String username)` — spawns `umount <targetPath>` on the stored row.
- A shared private `executeOperation` helper that: merges stderr into stdout (`redirectErrorStream(true)`) and captures it as one trimmed string via the retained `readProcessOutput` helper, awaits the exit code, and on any spawn/capture/wait failure falls back to `commandOutput` = exception message (or `"Command execution failed"`) with `exitCode = -1` — no exception propagates. It always inserts one `mount_logs` row (mountId, actor userId, operation, output, exitCode, status, `createdAt` now), then applies the state transition: MOUNT sets the row to `"MOUNTED"`/`"FAILED"` by exit code; UNMOUNT sets `"PENDING"` only on exit 0 and leaves the row untouched otherwise. It returns a `LinkedHashMap` keyed exactly `mountId`, `operation`, `commandOutput`, `exitCode`, `status` (`"SUCCESS"` iff exit 0).
